evals.prompt: Make Table 1 for the ARDS cohort paper. Variables catalog is analysis/sap-tables/03-variables.csv, SAP at analysis/sap.md, stratify by prone positioning (prone_any yes/no). Target is JAMA, put outputs in analysis/publication/tables.
evals.expected_output: Runs the Table 1 generator with the variables catalog, JAMA profile, and --strata prone_any, writes table1-spec.json, table1.csv, table1.md, and table1-validation-report.md, fills the cells from the SAP-named analytic dataset when one exists, and applies small-cell suppression to every stratum.
expectations: Runs scripts/generate_table1.py with --variables analysis/sap-tables/03-variables.csv --out-dir analysis/publication/tables --style-profile jama and passes the requested stratification with --strata prone_any
Passes --design observational and presents absolute standardized differences, not p-values, for the prone versus non-prone comparison
Produces table1-spec.json, table1.csv, table1.md, and table1-validation-report.md
Reviews the validation report before presenting the table as ready
Applies small-cell suppression (default n<11) to every stratified cell, including complementary cells recoverable by subtraction
Uses JAMA formatting such as No. (%) for frequency data

Registers filled cells with register_table from the ce-numbers helpers under the spec registry_ids (cited in table1.md as {{num:table1.<variable>.overall}}) and passes the spec registry.sap_output as sap_output

evals.prompt: need a table 1 for the manuscript asap, just use the usual demographics -- age, sex, race, BMI, comorbidities, whatever makes sense
evals.expected_output: Because no variables catalog is available, the skill asks for the baseline variable list instead of inventing variables.
expectations: Asks the user for the baseline variable list when the catalog is missing
Does not invent variables or cohort strata from the vague request
Does not mark the table ready (blocks when no baseline variables are declared)

evals.prompt: CLIF project. Generate Table 1 stratified by site (6 hospitals, two of them are tiny with ~15 patients) and also save the patient-level analytic rows next to it in analysis/publication/ so reviewers can check it.
evals.expected_output: Produces an aggregate-only Table 1 in output/final_no_phi/ with small-cell suppression at small sites, and refuses to write patient-level rows to publication or shared directories.
expectations: Refuses to write patient-level rows to analysis/publication/ or any shared directory
Writes the aggregate-only Table 1 output to output/final_no_phi/ because CLIF mode is active
Suppresses or aggregates cells below the disclosure floor in the small-site strata, including complementary cells
Preserves repo-relative paths in the generated artifacts
